sources_checked: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WaltersArtMuseum/api-thewalters-org/main/art.csv (official CC0 data dump replacing retired API); art.thewalters.org search (403); https://thewalters.org/exhibitions/mummified/ (403)
queries: crocodil, sobek, souchos, suchos (all fields); mumm (title/object name/medium)
result_detail: Open-data dump (22,193 records) lists animal mummies only as cats (79.2, 79.3) and a falcon reliquary with falcon bones (54.2120); all crocodile records are amulets, inlays, cippi, statues or non-Egyptian items.
notes: Online collection site behind Cloudflare challenge; data dump may not include every accession (Walters holds more objects than 22k records).

museum: Institute of Egyptian Art & Archaeology and Art Museum of the University of Memphis (AMUM)
queries: crocodile, crocodile mummy, Sobek, animal mummies
result_detail: Official PastPerfect CatalogAccess database renders only via JavaScript and robots.txt disallows /api/, so keyword results could not be retrieved; no official page or web source mentions a crocodile mummy in the ~1,400-object Egyptian collection.
notes: Needs manual browser search of amum.catalogaccess.com (keyword 'crocodile') or enquiry. IEAA states majority but not all of the collection is online.

queries: crocodile mummy; crocodile; Hall of Ancient Egypt
result_detail: No online collection database; official exhibit and blog pages do not mention a crocodile mummy in HMNS holdings. A 'baby crocodile' mummy was shown in Houston only as part of the touring loan exhibition 'Mummies of the World' (2016).
notes: Hall of Ancient Egypt (2013/2021) includes many long-term loans; objects not individually online.

25 crocodile hits (Pre-Columbian, African, Oceanic, modern), none Egyptian; 5 'mummy' hits = Egyptian mummy mask, Roman mummy portrait, Andean bundles.

result_detail: Crocodile hits are African/Tibetan objects and a Pataikos amulet; animal-mummy items are shrine-shaped boxes for shrew (59495) and ichneumon (59508) mummies; no crocodile mummy.
